Anima Morph @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.OsccN7Xj7vt1lHXS]{Anima Morph: Moonlit Frenzy}

Anima Ability @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.p7UdLnJOQx1MMi6j]{Anima Ability: Moonlit Frenzy}

You go into a frenzy and attack in wild bloodlust. For this spell, your anima weapon attacks gain the reach trait. If it already has the trait, you increase its reach by a further 5 feet.

For each action you spend on this spell, you can either Stride and then make an Anima Strike against a creature within your reach or make two Anima Strikes, each against a different creature. Each Strike you make counts towards your multi attack penalty, but you do not increase it until you have made all your attacks. If you only Stride half your speed or less, your movement does not trigger reactions.
